# Healthy AI Implementation Roadmap for Hospitals

## From Pilot to Production — A Step-by-Step Playbook for Hospital Leaders and Analysts

**85% of AI projects never reach production.** This book explains why — and gives you the roadmap to be in the 15% that succeed.

Written by a Senior Quality Analyst with 10+ years across 150+ hospitals, this is an organizational playbook for implementing AI as a sustainable, measurable, compliant operational capability.

### What's Inside

- **Governance Structure** — AI Steering Committee, RACI matrix, governance charter
- **Project Selection** — Weighted scoring matrix for picking the right projects
- **Data Readiness** — 5-dimension assessment with scoring thresholds
- **Make vs. Buy** — Decision framework for building, buying, or skipping
- **Vendor Selection** — 5-step process with assessment criteria
- **Pilot Playbook** — Scope, metrics, and 3-gate process
- **Integration** — Principles and checklist for clinical workflows
- **Change Management** — Getting clinicians and staff onboard
- **ROI Measurement** — Financial, clinical, and operational metrics
- **Scaling** — From pilot to department-wide deployment
- **Compliance & Ethics** — 4 compliance gates and ethics framework
- **Failure Protocols** — Pause, rollback, and no-blame culture
- **12-Month Roadmap** — Month-by-month implementation timeline

### Includes Practical Templates

- AI Governance Charter
- Project Selection Matrix
- Data Readiness Assessment
- RACI Matrix
- Pilot Gate Process
- ROI Calculation Template
- 12-Month Implementation Roadmap

### Part of the Practical AI in Healthcare Series

- Book 1: AI in Healthcare — The Do's and Don'ts
- Book 2: Stop AI From Leaking Patient Data
- Book 3: Healthy AI Implementation Roadmap for Hospitals (this book)

about_author:
Mohammed Imthiyaz A is a Senior Quality Analyst and Business Analyst with more than ten years of experience in healthcare IT. He has worked on Hospital Management Systems and healthcare technology across more than 150 hospitals in over 20 countries. His work sits at the intersection of clinical workflows, business analysis, quality assurance and technology.

This is the third book in the Practical AI in Healthcare series. Mohammed has published two previous books in this series: AI in Healthcare — The Do's and Don'ts, and Stop AI From Leaking Patient Data. He can be reached at imthiyazzilaan@gmail.com.
